prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1492; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a low-speed collision in a retail parking lot. Insured vehicle was reversing out of a space when it made contact with a claimant vehicle parked in the adjacent stall. Both drivers remained on scene. Claimant reported a head injury and was transported by ambulance for evaluation.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant confirmed no attorney is retained and prefers to handle the matter directly. Claimant describes ongoing headaches, light sensitivity, and dizziness since the incident. Medical records requested with signed authorization. Explained the claims process and the claimant's right to seek independent advice if desired.

Entry 3: Reviewed photos from both vehicles. Damage to claimant vehicle is consistent with a rear quarter panel impact. Insured vehicle shows minor front bumper scuffing. Parking lot surveillance footage requested from property management; retention window noted as limited, so preservation letter sent.

Entry 4: Received preliminary records from treating facility. Diagnosis listed as concussion with recommendation for rest and follow-up with neurology. Claimant reports missing several days of work and is awaiting employer documentation. Recorded symptom updates and advised claimant to keep a log of symptoms and medical appointments.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with claimant. Claimant reports symptoms are gradually improving but not fully resolved. Reminded claimant that medical expenses and lost wages will be evaluated once complete documentation is received. Claim remains open pending neurology report, vehicle repair estimate, and review of surveillance footage.
